figure1.LUAD_rule: BH FDR <= 0.05 AND NES > 0 AND expression logFC > 0
figure1.LUSC_mirror_rule: BH FDR <= 0.05 AND NES < 0 AND expression logFC < 0
figure1.external_role: independent same-rule validation; not an additional discovery filter

figure2.promoter_rule: open in at least half of samples in each of patient, PDX and cell-line systems
figure2.activity_rule: exclude only TFs whose mean LUAD NES is negative in all three systems
figure2.motif_rule: JASPAR-first/CIS-BP-fallback; HOMER q <= 1e-5 in at least half of all samples per system

figure3B.edge: two target genes are activated by at least two common HC-TFs

figure4.primary_significance: naive unadjusted log-rank P <= 0.05 at the selected cutpoint
figure4.multiplicity: adjusted maxstat and BH values retained in supplementary tables but do not decide the primary display
figure4.interpretation: exploratory association; not a multiplicity-controlled prognostic classifier
